scope.summary: Author the single Studio text primitive StudioTextStory (schema id hsk.studio.text_story@1) carried by a StudioLayer of kind text: character stream, per-range character attributes, per-paragraph attributes, style bindings, and a text_kind discriminator (point / area / path). No separate primitives for the source suites' point/artistic/paragraph/frame tools — they are text_kind values on one story. Implement non-destructive point<->area conversion preserving all character/paragraph attributes and style bindings. Reference canonical StudioTextStory from MT-002 primitives; never fork.
acceptance_criteria: StudioTextStory@1 with text_kind {point,area,path}; non-destructive point/area conversion; single primitive, no forks
expected_tests: live: point->area->point round-trip preserves char/para attrs + style bindings (non-destructive)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No shared text primitive; per-suite text tools re-forked (dedup violation); all typography MTs blocked.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
